proof.basis: Reviewed static A32 bytes and literal arithmetic only. Operand and semantic annotations are pinned review facts, not automatic source/original equivalence.

dependency.name: L07 full selector proof
dependency.scope: Chip selector 4 selects BM1368 constructor; output is backend+0x110 at cold call 0x73de8. The complete dispatcher is not reproved here.

domain: Ordinary valid readable model, backend, chain and device storage; all reached callbacks return synchronously
Constructor installation must succeed and the method slot must still contain the selected implementation when called
No asynchronous mutation, faults, exceptions or nonlocal returns
Opaque n*(n-1) bit0 predicates take their even-product edge under ordinary uint32 arithmetic
nonclaims: No firmware execution, CPU interpreter, oracle, hardware or native ABI compatibility
No complete coordinator, model/profile application or production driver binding
No equivalent hwscan startup coordinator is established
No guarantee every model enables the optional triple-reset flag or every startup reaches this call
No guarantee the register retains its value after later unreviewed operations

bit_permutation.high_bits: ignored by initial/final UXTB and masks

helper.proof: Low-byte mask then adjacent-bit, two-bit-group and nibble swaps map bit i to bit 7-i; disjoint OR terms are equal for every uint32 input. The name does not select a BM1398 driver.

method_contract.index: Reload device+0x18 after writer returns, then add one modulo 2^32
method_contract.effects: No wrapper wait, retry, second write or extra cache read; lower writer effects and diagnostics remain separate

caller.startup: prepare 0x7409c loads B through context+0x24 then device+0x14; 0x74914 launches 0x7bfc0(B), which calls 0x67ff8(B) at 0x7c05c; 0x69d98 calls 0x6c89c(B)
caller.resume: 0x70e30 preserves B in r4 and calls 0x6c89c at 0x7164c
caller.thread: 0x6dc98 launches 0x7863c with {B,C,B+0x50}; creation must succeed and the worker must run
caller.model: 0xa720c returns M+0x38; 0xa71f4 returns M+0x88 for nonzero M; NULL-preserving accessors do not validate the dereferenced model
caller.entry_flags: Board-view flags +0x44..+0x4d are read at entry; optional soft reset uses bit0 at +0x46, equivalent to M+0x7e
caller.B0: [C+0x1c] loaded at 0x55828 and saved at 0x55938; final mask uses this saved backend
caller.B1: [C+0x1c] reloaded at 0x55de4; three optional reset/mask pairs use this backend; earlier callbacks can make it differ from B0
caller.triple: If the entry soft-reset flag is set, each B1+0x1e8 callback must return zero before the corresponding B1+0x138 call with UINT32_MAX; every mask must succeed. Delay arguments 200 separate stages. Any failure records error and returns -1; this is not retry on failure.
caller.final: On prior-success path, third argument zero causes 0x562c4 to call saved B0+0x138 with D and a fresh [M+0xb0] word; delay argument 50 precedes it. This worker supplies zero, so successful final write can replace the earlier 0xff mask.
caller.lifetime: Flags are entry snapshots; final mask word and method slots are loaded later. B0 and B1 must not be assumed identical after callbacks; numeric constructor identities stay noncallable host data.
